« Laissez-le-nous. Ici, il ne sera pas u: “Leave him with us. Here, he won’t be merchandise. He will be protected by forty people who have nothing else left to defend.”
« Il décidera lui-même », dit Maëlle d’u: “He’ll decide for himself,” says Maëlle, her voice drained. Then, more quietly: “Or you will. He’ll listen to you.”

Vous mangez à l’abri d’une pile de l’aqu: You eat in the shelter of one of the aqueduct’s piers, watching the port. Somewhere over there are the Scrappers, Gaspard Lenoir and the Iron Bridge. And beyond that, the lock.
The group has made it out of the Labyrinth.
